summary: All four story checks ran and exited cleanly. The diff stays within the story's files list. The implementation matches each acceptance criterion I could read in code. I did not review the test bodies line by line; I relied on the pass counts and on reading io.py and schema.py. There is one low-severity note about make check coverage.

checks.criterion: make schema-check passes with no drift
checks.evidence: "JSON Schemas match schema.py: packages/schema/json". The diff adds product-record.schema.json and sources.schema.json.

checks.criterion: ProductRecord tests (missing field fails, signed URL rejected, etc.)
io tests (sha256, windowed GeoTIFF read, local Range server, 200 reply raises)

checks.evidence: ruff check passed, ruff format --check passed, mypy found no issues in 10 source files

checks.criterion: ProductRecord has exactly the PRD 8.12 fields, forbids extras, requires every field, accepts only the five verification statuses, takes a null or 64-hex checksum, and rejects signed or credentialed URLs
checks.evidence: schema.py ProductRecord lists the 19 required fields with no defaults. VerificationStatus has the five required values. SourceUrl combines a URL pattern with has_url_credentials, which covers signature=, token=, access_key, expires= and userinfo. The existing models are untouched in the diff. Extra constraints are a VERIFIED validator and a data/... local_path pattern.

checks.criterion: io.py provides sha256_file, fetch_range, a windowed GeoTIFF reader and read_product
checks.evidence: io.py:42 streams the checksum in chunks. fetch_range (io.py:378) sends a Range header, requires status 206 and a matching Content-Range, raises RangeNotSupportedError on 200, and wraps DNS and connection errors. read_geotiff_window (io.py:89) returns the array, nodata, CRS WKT and transform as stored. read_product (io.py:263) takes the checksum from the file, returns "unknown" units and status PARTIAL when units are missing, and raises if metadata units contradict the file.

checks.criterion: Dependencies and uv.lock stay consistent; no network in tests
checks.evidence: pyproject.toml adds affine and numpy, both already in the lock as rasterio dependencies. uv.lock matches, and make schema-check uses --locked and passed. fetch_range is exercised against a local 127.0.0.1 http.server, per the task.
Not checkable from the final diff; no pre-implementation run was available to me.

checks.criterion: Zod sources regenerated if T0-04 added them
checks.evidence: I did not look for zod-generation tooling, and the diff touches no zod files. The criterion applies only if T0-04 added them.

findings.claim: make check runs only ruff and mypy, not pytest. The tests are covered only by the separate pytest checks.
findings.evidence: make check output contained ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy only.
